observed_reference_properties: graph discovery separated from retired-history audit
crawler/index separated from source and reasoning

generic_mapping.mplpb_document_id: ContinuityRecord.record_id or provider-native source identity; a conforming provider must separately assign version_id
generic_mapping.mplpb_updated: ContinuityRecord.updated_evidence plus version after provider validation; source text alone is not timestamp proof
generic_mapping.mplpb_scope: ContinuityRecord.scope purpose; namespace, subject, and owner remain explicit provider fields
generic_mapping.mplpb_supersedes: ContinuityRecord predecessor/successor relations only after provider validation
generic_mapping.relative_path: payload_ref kind=corpus_relative and provider_native_ref; never a durability receipt
generic_mapping.search_result: record_retrieved stage only when an actual provider result and receipt exist
generic_mapping.filesystem_audit_retired_path: historical discovery input; not a mutation receipt

portability_contract.authoritative_root: provider-local configuration outside portable record identity
portability_contract.relocation_rule: Moving the complete provider root must not change record_id, version_id, scope, lineage, or normalized corpus-relative references.

not_proven_by_reference: rollback resistance or monotonic attempt state
conformance_rule: A future Local Mirror binding conforms only by implementing the generic schemas and lifecycle behind IF-CONTINUITY-PROVIDER and producing real operation-scoped evidence. The reference corpus alone is not a conforming provider.
